project.name: SSR.fun
project.oneLiner: A launchpad and trading interface for Decentralized Token Reserves on Solana, backed by a real deployed-to-DevNet Anchor program.

terminology.DecentralizedTokenReserve: The complete basket/product a user creates and trades. User-facing CTA is always 'Launch a Decentralized Token Reserve'.
terminology.Reserve: One underlying asset held inside a Decentralized Token Reserve. Never use alone to mean the whole basket in new copy.
terminology.ReserveToken: The fungible token representing ownership of a complete Decentralized Token Reserve.
terminology.onChainIdentifierException: The deployed Anchor account structs `Reserve`, `ReserveAsset`, `Delegate`, `ProtocolConfig` (programs/ssr_protocol/src/state/*.rs) keep their PRE-rename sense (Reserve = whole basket account) permanently, because Anchor derives each account's on-chain discriminator from its struct name at compile time -- renaming would break deserialization of every already-initialized DevNet account. This document reports those Rust struct/field names verbatim; do not reinterpret them.

executiveOverview.whatSsrIs: SSR.fun lets a user create a 'Decentralized Token Reserve' -- a basket of Solana SPL assets held in program-owned vaults -- and issue a fungible 'Reserve Token' representing proportional ownership. Holders mint/redeem in-kind against live vault balances (no oracle, no bonding curve). A real 23-instruction Anchor program is deployed and live on Solana DevNet and the frontend is wired directly to it for discovery, creation, buy/sell, and management -- this is materially more built-out than a pure UI mock, though it is still pre-mainnet, pre-audit, and single-key-controlled.
executiveOverview.currentProductState: Two coexisting design systems in one SPA: a small 'Native' system (Home page, global Shell/nav, toasts) and a larger 'Merge' system (Discover, Create, Portfolio, Manage, Reserve-detail) ported from a separate prototype and Tailwind/shadcn-styled. The Merge pages carry almost all real product functionality; the Native system is mostly the entry shell plus a fully self-contained, unused simulation sandbox (src/state/store.tsx) that no routed page currently reads from.
executiveOverview.frontendState: Hash-routed (no history-API router; a hand-rolled router at src/lib/router.tsx, with a wouter-API-compatible shim so the ported Merge pages needed no rewrite). Real Solana wallet connectivity via @solana/wallet-adapter-react (Wallet Standard, no bundled wallet packages). Real on-chain Reserve discovery (adaptive-polled, no getProgramAccounts -- blocked on public DevNet RPC). Real Buy/Sell, Create, and management transactions signed by the connected wallet. A simulated order book and a hardcoded DevNet test-price table sit underneath otherwise-real trading UI.
executiveOverview.protocolState: Deployed and live on Solana DevNet at program ID 2dURvmSdHeyaFES5rxaE1zgPSHCBLW5BLNguJ2Tu1mkW. 23 instructions covering protocol init, Reserve creation/seeding, in-kind mint/redeem, co-manager permissioning, fee accrual/collection, target-weight updates, composition management (add/fund/remove asset), and staged wind-down/close. 14/14 integration tests pass live against DevNet (tests/ssr_protocol.ts), including a cross-Reserve vault-isolation test the project's own docs call 'the single most important test in this suite'. No mainnet deployment, no external audit, single dev-controlled upgrade authority (flagged for multisig migration before any restricted beta).
executiveOverview.environmentState: Local dev works fully for the frontend (`npm run dev`) but the Solana localnet validator (`solana-test-validator`/`anchor test`) cannot run on the current Windows machine without Developer Mode enabled (symlink privilege error) -- Rust/cargo-build-sbf compiles fine, so localnet testing is a documented, currently-open gap. DevNet is the sole live chain environment and is the source of truth for all 'real' data in this app. Production is a deployed Vercel app at a custom domain, reading/writing the same DevNet program (there is no separate mainnet or staging protocol deployment).
executiveOverview.architectureMaturity: Post-MVP, pre-beta. Roadmap Phases 1-3 (Frontend Foundation, Protocol Research, Solana Architecture) are complete; Phase 4 (Core Solana Program) is 96% and Phase 5 (Client/Frontend Integration) is 99%; Phase 6 (DevNet Testing & Security Validation) is 89%; Phases 7-8 (Restricted Beta, Production Readiness) have not started (0%). See docs/project/PROJECT_STATUS.md for the authoritative, weighted roadmap this summary is derived from -- recompute from that file, do not hand-edit percentages here.
majorArchitecturalBoundaries: Native design system vs. Merge design system (CSS-token-scoped via `.merge-scope`, two parallel global stores, two parallel toast systems, both mounted for the whole app lifetime).

Simulated-only surfaces (native src/state/store.tsx sandbox, local co-manager CRUD in useAppStore, the DTRDetail simulated order book, hardcoded DevNet test asset prices) vs. real on-chain surfaces (wallet connectivity, Reserve discovery, Create/Buy/Sell/Manage transactions).
Public unauthenticated app surface vs. the single password-gated internal surface (/internal/status, /internal/feedback) behind Vercel Routing Middleware.

Client-exposed config (VITE_* env vars: RPC URL, program ID, cluster) vs. server-only secrets (DEVNET_SWAP_AUTHORITY_SECRET_KEY, HELIUS_RPC_URL, SSR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD) -- enforced by Vite's VITE_ prefix convention plus a same-origin RPC proxy that never forwards the real Helius URL/API key to the browser.

On-chain program state (Rust/Anchor, authoritative) vs. off-chain descriptive metadata (Reserve name/ticker/logo, resolved from a `metadata_uri` string field the program stores but does not validate).

nodes.label: Vercel Routing Middleware gate
nodes.purpose: The only auth gate in the app; scoped via config.matcher to /internal/status, /internal-status.html, /api/dashboard/content, /internal/feedback, /internal-feedback.html. Every other route is untouched.

nodes.label: POST /api/dashboard/login
nodes.purpose: Validates SSR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD (constant-time compare), applies in-memory rate-limit/lockout, issues the signed session cookie.

nodes.label: GET /api/dashboard/content
nodes.purpose: Re-verifies the session cookie independently of middleware, then reads and parses PROJECT_STATUS.md, DECISION_LOG.md, ENGINEERING_TIMELINE.md, REPO_METRICS.json fresh on every request (no cache).

nodes.label: POST /api/dashboard/logout
nodes.purpose: Clears the session cookie (Max-Age=0).

nodes.label: Dashboard session scheme
nodes.purpose: Stateless HMAC-SHA256 signed cookie (`ssr_dash_session`, 12h TTL). The HMAC key IS the dashboard password itself -- no separate signing secret, no server-side session store, no revocation mechanism besides rotating the password.
limitations: A leaked cookie is valid up to 12h with no server-side revocation.
Not IP/UA-bound -- a captured cookie is fully replayable.

nodes.label: parseMarkdown
nodes.purpose: Splits PROJECT_STATUS.md/DECISION_LOG.md into sections, extracts fenced ```json blocks, computes the weighted completion percentage, renders Markdown bodies to HTML via `marked` with zero sanitization.
limitations: dangerouslySetInnerHTML of unsanitized marked() output -- safe only because docs/project/*.md is maintainer-authored, not user-submitted; would become an XSS vector if that trust assumption ever changes.

nodes.label: POST /api/devnet/faucet-devusdc
nodes.purpose: Mints 500 test devUSDC to a user wallet (500 claim / 2000 balance ceiling / 60s cooldown), signed entirely by the shared DevNet authority -- no user signature needed since funds only flow in.

nodes.label: POST /api/devnet/sponsor-sol
nodes.purpose: Transfers up to 1 SOL to a user wallet (2 SOL balance ceiling / 24h cooldown / 0.05 SOL authority reserve floor), fails honestly with sponsorExhausted rather than fabricating success.

nodes.label: POST /api/devnet/mint-test-assets
nodes.purpose: Mints allowlisted DevNet fixture/devUSDC test assets to a user wallet for Create-Reserve funding (1000-token per-mint cap, no cooldown).
limitations: Does not call assertDevnetCluster (no live genesis-hash check), unlike faucet-devusdc/sponsor-sol -- relies solely on the resolved RPC URL and the authority's DevNet-only mint control.

nodes.label: POST /api/devnet/swap-sign
nodes.purpose: The Buy/Sell zap co-signer. Independently re-derives every PDA and re-fetches live on-chain Reserve state (never trusts client-claimed amounts/mints), partially signs with the shared authority, returns the transaction for the user's wallet to complete.
limitations: Also does not call assertDevnetCluster.
buy-devusdc explicitly rejects non-100%-devUSDC Reserves (no real devUSDC-conversion instruction exists on-chain yet).
No temporal rate limit at all on this endpoint -- relies entirely on the protocol's atomic accounting plus a SOL-sufficiency pre-check.

nodes.label: GET /api/devnet/landing-stats
nodes.purpose: Public, unauthenticated, read-only real KPI aggregation (holder counts, 24h volume from decoded mint/redeem events) across every discovered Reserve, 60s in-memory cache.

nodes.label: POST /api/devnet/rpc-proxy
nodes.purpose: The only RPC path the production browser ever calls -- allowlists 9 JSON-RPC methods, caps batch size/body bytes, per-IP throttles, falls back to the public DevNet RPC on transport failure (never retries sendTransaction).

nodes.label: loadDevnetAuthority
nodes.purpose: Loads the single shared DevNet authority Keypair from DEVNET_SWAP_AUTHORITY_SECRET_KEY, reused across 4 roles (swap co-signer, devUSDC mint/freeze authority, SOL sponsor, test-asset mint authority) -- a deliberate, documented tradeoff.

nodes.label: assertDevnetCluster
nodes.purpose: Live genesis-hash check that fails closed if the connected RPC isn't actually DevNet.
limitations: Only called by faucet-devusdc.ts and sponsor-sol.ts -- swap-sign.ts and mint-test-assets.ts skip this check, an asymmetric defense-in-depth gap.

nodes.label: In-memory rate limiting
nodes.purpose: Module-scope Map-based cooldowns/sliding windows for login lockout, faucet/sponsor cooldowns, and rpc-proxy throttling.
limitations: Not durable/shared across concurrent Vercel Fluid Compute instances -- resets on cold start. Every fund-touching endpoint's real defense is a live on-chain balance ceiling or atomic program accounting, not these counters.

nodes.label: resolveRpcUrl
nodes.purpose: HELIUS_RPC_URL || SOLANA_RPC_URL || public DevNet RPC fallback; documents that the Helius URL must never be echoed to the browser.
limitations: HELIUS_RPC_URL and SOLANA_RPC_URL are read by this code but undocumented in .env.example -- a real gap between code and env documentation.

flows.name: Browse Reserves
flows.summary: A visitor sees every genuinely-deployed on-chain Decentralized Token Reserve on Home and Discover, discovered live from Solana DevNet, not from a fixed list.

steps.description: App mounts; RealReserveSync starts an adaptive poll (15s base, backs off to 120s under rate limiting).
discoverAllReserves walks reserve_id 0..ProtocolConfig.reserveCount-1 via direct account fetches (getProgramAccounts is blocked on the public DevNet RPC).
Discovered accounts are merged into useAppStore.dtrs (fail-closed: a Reserve no longer confirmed on a later pass is dropped).
Home selects a Featured subset; Discover renders the full, searchable/filterable/sortable catalog. Both use the shared ReserveCard via an adapter.
Home also fetches a real KPI summary (holder count, 24h volume) from the landing-stats endpoint, showing 'unavailable' rather than a fabricated number on failure.

limitations: Two known-abandoned/zero-asset Reserves (IDs 6, 12, 18) are explicitly hidden via a hardcoded address registry, not a structural rule -- see DEC-0058/DEC-0064.

flows.name: View Reserve Details
flows.summary: A visitor opens a Reserve's detail page and sees real composition/price data plus a simulated order book.

steps.description: Route matches /dtr/:dtrId; DTRDetail looks up the Reserve from useAppStore's already-discovered catalog.
Composition pie and NAV/AUM figures come from real vault balances, valued using a hardcoded DevNet test-price table (no oracle exists on-chain).
Price chart is built from real recorded trades (recordConfirmedTrade) once any Buy/Sell has occurred; the order book shown alongside it is entirely client-generated (SimulatedOrderBook).

limitations: Order book has no on-chain counterpart -- do not present it as real market depth.

flows.name: Create a Decentralized Token Reserve
flows.summary: A connected wallet launches a brand-new Reserve via a multi-step wizard that submits real, signed Solana DevNet transactions.

steps.description: User fills name/ticker/description/category, asset composition (weights), fee config, and co-managers across the CreateDTR wizard.
Transaction 1: one combined transaction bundling createReserve + initializeReserveAsset (one per asset), wallet-signed.

Funding step: SPL test assets are minted to the user via the server faucet (api/devnet/mint-test-assets), OR wrapped SOL is self-wrapped client-side (ATA create + SystemProgram.transfer + syncNative).
Transaction 2: seedReserve -- first in-kind deposit, transitions Reserve.status Created/AssetsInitializing -> Active, mints initial Reserve Tokens to the manager.
Mid-flight progress is checkpointed to localStorage so a page refresh can resume/reconcile rather than silently re-submitting.
RealReserveSync's next poll picks up the new Reserve and it appears in Discover/Home like any other.

limitations: A stale-closure bug that produced misleading '(setup)' failures and blocked duplicate-prevention was fixed 2026-07-31 (DEC-0063); skipPreflight + a re-entrancy guard were added as part of that fix.

flows.name: Wallet Connection
flows.summary: Requested under the name 'simulated wallet connection', but wallet connectivity in this app is REAL, not simulated: genuine Wallet Standard connections via @solana/wallet-adapter-react. The only simulated element is the MetaMask option, kept solely to exercise a deterministic failure path (MetaMask has no Solana support).

steps.description: User opens WalletModal and picks Phantom, Solflare, or Backpack (detected via WalletReadyState).
wallet-adapter-react performs the real browser-extension connection handshake.
WalletSync bridges the connected publicKey into useAppStore and starts a real 20s SOL-balance poll.
Selecting MetaMask deliberately never completes a connection -- this path exists to verify the app's failure-state UI, not as a real integration.

flows.name: Portfolio Flow
flows.summary: A connected wallet views its real Reserve Token holdings, P&L, and can onboard with DevNet test funds.

steps.description: Portfolio reads real holdings synced by RealReserveSync (per-Reserve Token balance reads via fetchTokenBalanceRaw).
P&L math (calculations.ts) computes cost-basis/unrealized figures from recorded real trades.
DevnetOnboarding panel offers real devUSDC faucet claims and SOL sponsorship for wallets that need DevNet funds to participate.

flows.name: Manage Reserve Flow
flows.summary: A Reserve's manager (or a permitted co-manager) administers composition, co-managers, and lifecycle state via real on-chain instructions.

steps.description: Manage lists Reserves where the connected wallet is manager or an on-chain-verified co-manager (isManagerOrDelegate).
ManageDTR decodes each co-manager's real permission bitmask via decodeOnChainPermissions for display -- this is read-only decoding of genuine chain state, not a local list.
Composition actions (update targets, add/fund/remove asset) call managementClient, each a single wallet-signed transaction enforcing the manager/co-manager permission flag on-chain.
Wind-down/close (root-manager-only, no co-manager path) transitions Active -> WindDown -> Closed once supply and vault balances are zero.

limitations: Co-Manager ADD/REMOVE/rebalance actions exposed via useAppStore's local sandbox actions are NOT part of this real flow -- those are simulation-only and never touch chain; real co-manager management goes only through managementClient's on-chain instructions.

flows.name: Buy / Mint Reserve Token
flows.summary: A connected wallet buys into a Reserve; SOL or devUSDC is converted (server-cosigned) into the underlying assets, which are then deposited via a real in-kind mint instruction.

steps.description: User enters a buy amount on DTRDetail; client requests a quote/transaction from the server.

swap-sign.ts re-derives the Reserve's PDAs from only the Reserve address, fetches live on-chain state, verifies every asset mint is allowlisted and the Reserve is Active, then builds the zap instructions and partially signs with the shared swap authority.
The connected wallet completes the signature; the transaction (fee-payer = user) is submitted with skipPreflight and confirmed via bounded polling.
mint_reserve_tokens_in_kind computes the proportional required per-asset amounts against live vault/supply ratios, charges the mint fee, and mints net Reserve Tokens to the buyer.
A confirmed trade is recorded into the Reserve's price history in useAppStore.

limitations: 'buy-devusdc' is explicitly rejected server-side for Reserves that are not 100% devUSDC-backed (no real devUSDC-conversion instruction exists on-chain) -- the endpoint returns a distinguishable error rather than silently substituting a different path.
USD-denominated amounts still rely on the hardcoded DevNet test-price table.

flows.name: Redeem / Sell Reserve Token
flows.summary: A connected wallet sells/redeems Reserve Tokens; for pure-devUSDC Reserves this pays the user directly from the protocol's own redemption instruction with no swap-authority co-signature at all.

steps.description: User enters a sell amount; client requests a transaction from the server.
If the Reserve is 100% devUSDC-backed, swap-sign.ts builds buildRedeemToDevUsdcInstructions -- pure protocol redemption, no swap-authority signature needed at all.
Otherwise, buildSellZapInstructions pays the user the full sale proceeds out of the swap authority's own real SOL balance (pre-checked for sufficiency before signing).

redeem_reserve_tokens_in_kind burns the full redeemed amount, computes net-of-fee payout, and transfers proportional assets out of the vaults; redemption is allowed even while a Reserve is Paused or in WindDown.
Wallet completes/submits/confirms the transaction; a confirmed trade is recorded.

limitations: Non-devUSDC-backed Sell still depends on the shared authority wallet's own SOL balance, documented as an elevated operational risk (0.2345 SOL observed at last status update, funding 4 separate duties).

flows.name: Internal Status Login
flows.summary: A team member authenticates to the single password-gated internal surface.

steps.description: Middleware intercepts /internal/status (and its data endpoint) before the cache; an unauthenticated request only ever receives the login page HTML embedded in middleware.ts itself.

Submitting the password posts to /api/dashboard/login, which checks SSR_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD with a constant-time comparison and applies in-memory lockout (10 attempts / 10 min window / 15 min lockout, production-only by default).
On success, a stateless HMAC-signed session cookie (ssr_dash_session, 12h TTL, HMAC key = the password itself) is set and the page reloads.
The same cookie/session also gates /internal/feedback -- one login covers both pages.

limitations: No revocation mechanism for a leaked cookie short of rotating the password.
Rate-limit lockout state is in-memory only, reset on cold start -- best-effort, not durable.

flows.name: Internal Dashboard Data Loading
flows.summary: The authenticated internal dashboard renders project status straight from Markdown/JSON files, computed fresh on every request.

steps.description: Dashboard.tsx fetches GET /api/dashboard/content with credentials on mount.
content.ts independently re-verifies the session cookie (never trusts middleware alone), then reads all 4 source files fresh via fs.readFileSync, no caching.

parseMarkdown.ts splits sections, extracts fenced JSON blocks, computes the weighted overall completion percentage from the Engineering Areas (falling back to the Roadmap) block, and renders remaining Markdown bodies to raw HTML.
Dashboard.tsx renders the roadmap, current mission/blockers, engineering areas, milestones, repo metrics panel, engineering timeline, full decision log, and a collapsed 'Operational Detail' section.

limitations: Rendered Markdown bodies use dangerouslySetInnerHTML with zero sanitization -- acceptable only while docs/project/*.md remains maintainer-only content.

flows.name: Protocol Instruction Submission (generic)
flows.summary: The general path any real on-chain action in this app takes, from a wallet click to a confirmed DevNet transaction.

steps.description: A client lib (createReserveClient, managementClient, or zapClient) builds one or more instructions via an SDK builder function.
Any needed server-side co-signature (only for Buy/Sell) is obtained from api/devnet/swap-sign.ts; otherwise the transaction is single-signer.
The connected wallet signs; the transaction is submitted with skipPreflight:true through the RPC proxy.
Confirmation is polled with a bounded retry loop (confirmSignatureBounded) rather than a websocket subscription, since the latter was observed itself throwing 429s.
The Anchor program validates all `has_one`/`constraint`/PDA-seed checks and mutates the relevant account(s) atomically; an event is emitted.

The frontend's next discovery/sync poll (or an immediate balance re-read) reflects the new chain state -- this refresh-from-chain step is a documented, binding invariant for every state-changing action in this app.

flows.name: DevNet Onboarding Interaction
flows.summary: A wallet with no DevNet funds gets a small amount of real test SOL and devUSDC to begin participating.

steps.description: User clicks Claim devUSDC / Request SOL in the Portfolio onboarding panel.
Server verifies the connected RPC is genuinely DevNet via a live genesis-hash check before touching any funds.
Cooldown + durable balance-ceiling checks run (500 devUSDC claim / 2000 ceiling / 60s cooldown; 1 SOL grant / 2 SOL ceiling / 24h cooldown, and the authority itself must keep a 0.05 SOL reserve).
The shared authority signs and submits the mint/transfer; the endpoint returns a real signature and Explorer link, or an honest failure (e.g. sponsorExhausted) if the authority itself is too low.

flows.name: Deployment Flow
flows.summary: How a change reaches Production -- confirmed manual, not CI/CD-automated.

steps.description: Frontend changes are built locally/in CI via `tsc -b && vite build`, producing 3 separate bundles (main, internalStatus, internalFeedback).
Deployment to Vercel is manual (`vercel --prod`) -- vercel.json sets git.deploymentEnabled: false, so pushing to GitHub does NOT auto-deploy.
vercel.json's functions.includeFiles wiring ensures api/dashboard/content.ts can read docs/project/*.{md,json} at runtime in the deployed function.

Protocol changes follow a separate manual path: `anchor build`/`cargo-build-sbf` (native Windows toolchain, anchor test does not run locally) then a manual `solana program deploy`/upgrade against DevNet, recorded by hand in docs/protocol/DEVNET_RUNBOOK.md and DECISION_LOG.md.

limitations: No CI/CD pipeline automates either the frontend or protocol deploy path -- both are manual, human-run commands, tracked only in documentation, not in a pipeline config.

flows.name: Repository Metrics Generation
flows.summary: Repo metrics shown on the internal dashboard are generated by a real git-inspecting script, not hand-maintained.

steps.description: A developer runs `npx ts-node -P scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/generate-repo-metrics.ts` from a shell with git available.
The script shells out to git for commit counts, per-contributor counts (flagging AI-assisted commits via a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer), branches, LOC, and a per-day commit-activity series.
It also regex-scans docs/project/DECISION_LOG.md for decision count and programs/ssr_protocol/src/instructions/mod.rs for instruction count.
Output is written directly to docs/project/REPO_METRICS.json, committed like any other doc file, and later served verbatim by api/dashboard/content.ts.

limitations: This cannot run inside the deployed Vercel function itself (no git binary at request time) -- it is an out-of-band, manually-triggered step, not part of the request path.

flows.name: Project-Status Documentation Parsing
flows.summary: How the hand-written PROJECT_STATUS.md/DECISION_LOG.md Markdown becomes the structured data the dashboard renders.

steps.description: splitSections() splits each file on '\n## ' headers into a title->body map.

extractFencedJson() pulls out ```json fenced blocks per section (Roadmap, Engineering Areas, Milestones, Timeline, Infrastructure) and JSON.parses them -- these are the only machine-readable parts of otherwise free-form Markdown.

parseProjectStatus() computes weightedCompletionPercent() from the Engineering Areas array (falling back to the Roadmap array if that section is absent) -- this is the ONLY place the overall completion percentage is computed; it is never hand-typed.
parseDecisionLog() splits on '\n## DEC-', extracts each entry's fenced JSON, and sorts descending by ID.
Remaining prose sections (Executive Summary, Risks, Blockers, etc.) are rendered to HTML via `marked` and returned as *Html fields, unsanitized.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
instructions.purpose: Creates the singleton ProtocolConfig PDA; sets authority/caps/default fee destination.
instructions.authority: First-run signer becomes ProtocolConfig.authority (no prior-authority check possible).

instructions.name: create_reserve
instructions.purpose: Creates a new Reserve PDA + its Reserve Token mint with an embedded fee config.
instructions.authority: Signer `manager` becomes Reserve.manager; requires ProtocolConfig.paused == false.

instructions.name: initialize_reserve_asset
instructions.purpose: Registers a ReserveAsset + its vault during pre-Active creation.
instructions.authority: has_one = manager. Validates Token-2022 extensions, rejecting TransferFeeConfig/TransferHook/PermanentDelegate/NonTransferable/ConfidentialTransferMint.

instructions.name: seed_reserve
instructions.purpose: First in-kind deposit; transitions Reserve to Active and mints initial Reserve Tokens.
instructions.authority: has_one = manager. Each asset's seed amount must be >= 1000 (MIN_SEED_AMOUNT_PER_ASSET).

instructions.name: mint_reserve_tokens_in_kind
instructions.purpose: Permissionless proportional in-kind mint against live vault/supply ratio; charges mint fee split into pending manager/protocol shares.
instructions.authority: No co-manager/manager gate -- any depositor, subject to caller-supplied slippage caps.

instructions.name: redeem_reserve_tokens_in_kind
instructions.purpose: Burns Reserve Tokens for a proportional net-of-fee payout.
instructions.authority: Owner of the redeemer's token account only. Deliberately allowed while Paused or in WindDown (never blocked by protocol-wide pause either).

instructions.name: update_targets
instructions.purpose: Updates each ReserveAsset.target_weight_bps (intent only, no transfer).
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with UPDATE_TARGETS.

instructions.name: add_delegate
instructions.purpose: Creates a Co-Manager PDA with a permission bitmask.
instructions.authority: Restricted co-manager: needs ADD_RESTRICTED_DELEGATE. Unrestricted co-manager: root manager only.

instructions.name: update_delegate_permissions
instructions.purpose: Changes an existing co-manager's permission bitmask.
instructions.authority: Same restricted/unrestricted branching as add_delegate.

instructions.name: remove_delegate
instructions.purpose: Closes a Co-Manager PDA.
instructions.authority: Same restricted/unrestricted branching (REMOVE_RESTRICTED_DELEGATE or root manager).

instructions.name: transfer_reserve_manager
instructions.purpose: Reassigns Reserve.manager.
instructions.authority: Root-exclusive -- no co-manager permission flag ever grants this.

instructions.name: pause_reserve
instructions.purpose: Active -> Paused.
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with PAUSE_RESERVE.

instructions.name: unpause_reserve
instructions.purpose: Paused -> Active.
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with UNPAUSE_RESERVE.

instructions.name: accrue_fees
instructions.purpose: Permissionless linear daily TVL-fee checkpoint into pending manager/protocol fee shares.
instructions.authority: None -- callable by anyone, no-op unless a full day has elapsed.

instructions.name: collect_fees
instructions.purpose: Mints pending fee shares to fixed, on-chain-validated destinations.
instructions.authority: Caller is permissionless (pays ATA rent only); destinations are hard-checked against Reserve.fee_config.fee_destination and ProtocolConfig.default_protocol_fee_destination.

instructions.name: record_rebalance
instructions.purpose: Audit-trail event only -- records caller-supplied before/after balances; does NOT execute any trade.
instructions.authority: Co-Manager/manager with EXECUTE_REBALANCE.
instructions.limitation: balances_before is caller-supplied and not independently verified on-chain -- a documented limitation.

instructions.name: update_metadata
instructions.purpose: Updates Reserve.metadata_uri.
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with UPDATE_METADATA.

instructions.name: update_protocol_config
instructions.purpose: Updates the protocol-wide default fee destination/bps.
instructions.authority: has_one = authority (protocol authority only).

instructions.name: add_reserve_asset_active
instructions.purpose: Adds a new zero-balance ReserveAsset to an already-Active Reserve.
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with MANAGE_LIQUIDITY_CONFIG.

instructions.name: fund_new_reserve_asset
instructions.purpose: One-time manager-only bootstrap transfer into a zero-balance vault (no Reserve Tokens minted).
instructions.authority: has_one = manager, no co-manager path.

instructions.name: remove_reserve_asset
instructions.purpose: Removes the last-registered, zero-balance ReserveAsset and closes its vault.
instructions.authority: Manager or a co-manager with MANAGE_LIQUIDITY_CONFIG.

instructions.name: initiate_wind_down
instructions.purpose: Active -> WindDown (one-way). Mint authority deliberately left intact so collect_fees still works.
instructions.authority: has_one = manager, root-exclusive, no co-manager path.

instructions.name: close_reserve
instructions.purpose: WindDown -> Closed; closes every ReserveAsset/vault account. Requires zero supply and zero vault balances.
instructions.authority: has_one = manager, root-exclusive, no co-manager path.

accounts.name: ProtocolConfig
accounts.note: Can pause protocol-wide creation/seeding/minting, but per its own code comment can never move a token out of any already-created Reserve's vaults.

accounts.name: Reserve
accounts.note: This is the 'whole basket' account, using the pre-terminology-rename sense of 'Reserve' -- see project.terminology.onChainIdentifierException.

accounts.name: ReserveAsset
accounts.seeds: config: ["reserve_asset", reserve, asset_mint]; vault: ["reserve_vault", reserve, asset_mint]

accounts.name: Delegate
accounts.note: Bits 10-15 reserved and must be zero.

accounts.name: reserve_token_mint (unnamed struct, real SPL Mint)
fields: standard SPL Mint fields; decimals fixed at 6; mint authority = mint_authority PDA; no freeze authority (DEC-0011)

permissionlessInstructions: redeem_reserve_tokens_in_kind (token-account owner only, no co-manager gate)
collect_fees (anyone can trigger; destinations are hard-validated, not caller-supplied)
authoritiesAndAccessControl.protocolWidePause: ProtocolConfig.paused gates ONLY create_reserve and seed_reserve/mint_reserve_tokens_in_kind. There is no dedicated pause/unpause-protocol instruction -- only per-Reserve pause/unpause exist as callable instructions.
authoritiesAndAccessControl.reserveLevelPause: Reserve.require_not_paused() gates update_targets/add_delegate/update_delegate_permissions. Reserve.require_redemption_allowed() (Active/Paused/WindDown all allowed) gates only redemption -- redemption is never blockable.
authoritiesAndAccessControl.crossReserveIsolation: Structural, not just a convention: every asset-leg helper (load_asset_legs, load_reserve_asset_configs, close_reserve's closing loop) re-derives the expected ReserveAsset/vault PDA from (reserve_key, asset_mint) and require_keys_eq!-checks it against the supplied account -- a substituted account from a different Reserve fails this check before any token transfer runs. Verified live by the 'cross-Reserve isolation' test in tests/ssr_protocol.ts, which the test suite's own comments call the single most important test in the file.

protocolArchitecture.tokenCustody: Each ReserveAsset's vault is a standard SPL token account owned by a PDA-derived vault_authority (seeds: ["vault_authority", reserve]) -- no human keypair ever custodies vault funds directly; only the program itself can sign for vault authority via seeds.
protocolArchitecture.mintRedeemMechanics: Oracle-free, proportional, in-kind only. Mint: required per-asset deposit = ceil(tokensRequested * vaultBalanceBefore / totalSupplyBefore), fee charged in Reserve Tokens (ceil), depositor receives net shares, fee shares accrue as pending (not minted yet). Redeem: burns the full requested Reserve Token amount, payout computed net of redemption fee (fee-backing stays in vault, accretive to remaining holders).
protocolArchitecture.managementControls: update_targets (intent-only reweighting), add_reserve_asset_active / fund_new_reserve_asset / remove_reserve_asset (composition changes -- add/remove are permission-gated, funding is manager-only and one-time), record_rebalance (audit-log only, no trade execution on-chain).
protocolArchitecture.pauseControls: Per-Reserve pause_reserve/unpause_reserve (permission-gated); no protocol-wide pause instruction exists despite ProtocolConfig having a `paused` field checked elsewhere.
protocolArchitecture.delegates: Two-tier: 'unrestricted' co-managers can only be granted/revoked by the root manager; 'restricted' co-managers can be granted/revoked by anyone holding ADD_RESTRICTED_DELEGATE/REMOVE_RESTRICTED_DELEGATE (which unrestricted co-managers may hold). Every permission is a single bit in a u16 mask, checked per-instruction via require_reserve_permission.
protocolArchitecture.fees: Per-Reserve FeeConfig: mint_fee_bps, redemption_fee_bps, annual_tvl_fee_bps (linear, not compounding, accrued daily via accrue_fees), manager_fee_share_bps/protocol_fee_share_bps splitting every fee event, fee_destination (manager-side) plus ProtocolConfig.default_protocol_fee_destination (protocol-side). All current bps values are documented as provisional DevNet placeholders (DEC-0013), not production-final economics.

sdkAndClient.package: @ssr/sdk (packages/sdk), workspace dependency of the root app (package.json `"@ssr/sdk": "*"`)
sdkAndClient.shape: No single heavyweight client class -- SsrClient (client.ts) is a deliberately minimal v1 skeleton (one method, fetchReserveAssets, throws 'not implemented' by design). Real functionality is a set of free functions: pda.ts (address derivation mirroring the Rust seeds exactly), calculations.ts (pure BigInt mint/redeem/entitlement math), discovery.ts (enumerative on-chain discovery, never getProgramAccounts), readOnly.ts (account fetchers + KPI helpers), createReserveFlow.ts / managementInstructions.ts / zapInstructions.ts (instruction builders consumed directly by frontend lib files and by api/devnet/swap-sign.ts), fixtures.ts / devUsdc.ts (typed views over generated fixture JSON), hiddenReserves.ts (the abandoned/hidden Reserve address registry).

testCoverage.programIntegrationTests: tests/ssr_protocol.ts -- Anchor/mocha/chai, run live against DevNet via `npm run test:program`. 14/14 passing as of the last recorded run (2026-07-28, per docs/protocol/TEST_PLAN.md). Covers: protocol init idempotency and re-init rejection, a full two-asset Reserve lifecycle (create/register/seed/mint/redeem/pause/unpause), a co-manager privilege-boundary check (a co-manager scoped to only UPDATE_TARGETS cannot call pause_reserve), and the cross-Reserve vault-substitution isolation test.
testCoverage.offlineUnitTests: tests/phase_*.ts (9 files) -- pure-logic mocha/chai tests over frontend (src/merge/lib/*) and SDK helper functions, explicitly documented as NOT hitting the network; the counterpart live-DevNet verification for each phase is a separate scripts/verify_*.ts run.
testCoverage.liveDevnetVerificationScripts: scripts/verify_*.ts (~18 scripts) -- each calls real, unmodified production code paths against live DevNet using a disposable funded keypair, standing in for a real browser+wallet click-through that no browser-automation tool in this environment can currently perform. This is explicitly documented as the project's actual substitute for end-to-end browser testing.
testCoverage.knownGap: No automated browser+wallet (e.g. Playwright+Phantom) end-to-end test exists; PROJECT_STATUS.md lists a real browser+Phantom click-through as never having been performed.

persistentFixtures.note: A genuine abandoned Reserve stuck in AssetsInitializing -- kept deliberately as a real fixture demonstrating that failure mode, not deleted.

fixtureWallets: holderA-keypair.json / holderB-keypair.json (test holders, ~99,500 Reserve Tokens each recorded in checkpoint.json)
delegatePause-keypair.json / delegateTargets-keypair.json (restricted co-managers for testing specific permission flags)
devnetFixtures.checkpointFile: devnet-fixtures/checkpoint.json -- a resumable progress record (not just a static config) for the scripted fixture-provisioning run; feeds packages/sdk/fixtures/devnet-fixtures.json used by both the frontend and api/devnet/swap-sign.ts's allowlist.
devnetFixtures.gitStatus: .gitignore lists devnet-fixtures/ under its Solana/Anchor section, yet checkpoint.json and the keypair files were present and readable in this working tree -- worth confirming whether they are actually tracked (force-added) or merely present locally; see risksAndGaps.

risksAndGaps.title: Single dev-controlled program upgrade authority
risksAndGaps.description: The Anchor program's upgrade authority is one keypair (6idsSUE6u7fqHg6edrdMEjNTnG62wyCANAsJ2YBmeuHk), not a multisig. Documented as a required migration before any restricted beta (DEC-0015) but not yet done.

risksAndGaps.title: One DevNet authority keypair serves four distinct fund-touching roles
risksAndGaps.description: DEVNET_SWAP_AUTHORITY_SECRET_KEY is reused as the swap co-signer, devUSDC mint/freeze authority, SOL sponsor, and test-asset mint authority. Deliberate and documented (Phase B security model), but concentrates risk in one secret, and its SOL balance was recorded at only 0.2345 SOL against 4 duties at last status update.

risksAndGaps.title: Inconsistent live-DevNet self-verification across fund-touching endpoints
risksAndGaps.description: faucet-devusdc.ts and sponsor-sol.ts call assertDevnetCluster (live genesis-hash check) before touching funds; swap-sign.ts and mint-test-assets.ts do not, despite both being documented as DevNet-only.

risksAndGaps.title: All rate limiting/cooldowns are in-memory, non-durable across serverless instances
risksAndGaps.description: Login lockout, faucet/sponsor cooldowns, and rpc-proxy throttling all use module-scope Maps that reset on cold start and are not shared across concurrent Vercel Fluid Compute instances. The project's real defense in every fund-touching case is a live on-chain balance ceiling or atomic program accounting, not these counters -- but this should not be mistaken for a durable rate limit.

risksAndGaps.title: Dashboard renders maintainer Markdown to HTML with zero sanitization
risksAndGaps.description: lib/dashboard/parseMarkdown.ts pipes `marked` output straight into dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Safe only while docs/project/*.md remains maintainer-only content; would become an XSS vector the moment that trust assumption changes (e.g. accepting docs from external contributors).

risksAndGaps.title: Dashboard session cookie has no server-side revocation
risksAndGaps.description: The stateless HMAC-signed session cookie (12h TTL, signing key = the dashboard password itself) cannot be individually revoked; the only way to invalidate a leaked cookie is rotating the shared password, which also breaks login for everyone using the old password.

risksAndGaps.title: HELIUS_RPC_URL and SOLANA_RPC_URL are read by server code but absent from .env.example
risksAndGaps.description: api/devnet/_lib/rpc.ts reads both directly; HELIUS_RPC_URL in particular determines whether getProgramAccounts-dependent features (landing-stats holder counts) work in production at all, yet neither variable is documented for a new contributor.

risksAndGaps.title: Reserve detail page's order book is entirely client-generated
risksAndGaps.description: SimulatedOrderBook has no on-chain counterpart -- there is no real order book for any Reserve. Must not be presented to users or stakeholders as genuine market depth.

risksAndGaps.title: USD/NAV/AUM figures depend on a hardcoded DevNet test-price table, not an oracle
risksAndGaps.description: TEST_ASSET_PRICES_USD / SOL_TEST_PRICE_USD are fixed constants (e.g. SOL=$20). Vault balances themselves are real, but any USD-denominated figure derived from them is only as good as this static table -- there is no price oracle integration anywhere in the deployed program or SDK.

risksAndGaps.title: No real devUSDC-to-Reserve-Asset conversion instruction exists on-chain
risksAndGaps.description: api/devnet/swap-sign.ts explicitly rejects a 'buy-devusdc' request for any Reserve that isn't 100% devUSDC-backed, specifically to avoid the swap authority silently funding non-devUSDC legs for free -- a real integration gap, not a UI-only limitation, and unresolved as of the last decision log entry (DEC-0065).

risksAndGaps.title: Genuine on-chain 'redeem and swap' via Jupiter proven infeasible on DevNet
risksAndGaps.description: Phase E of the DevNet implementation plan concluded a real Jupiter-routed swap is not feasible on DevNet (DEC-0045); resolved into a deferred, separate experimental ssr_devnet_amm program (DEC-0051) whose resume-or-defer status is still an open decision.

risksAndGaps.title: The entire native src/state/store.tsx simulation system is unused by any routed page
risksAndGaps.description: Its mint/redeem/rebalance/create-reserve actions and src/data/{assets,reserves,mock}.ts seed data are fully self-contained, in-memory, and not read by Home or any Merge page -- yet still mounted app-wide (its toasts still render in Shell). Represents real duplication/dead-weight risk versus the real useAppStore.

risksAndGaps.title: Two global stores and two toast systems run simultaneously for the app's whole lifetime
risksAndGaps.description: Native useStore()/Shell's own toast tray coexist with merge useAppStore()/useToast()+Toaster, mounted at the same time in App.tsx. Increases the chance a future change updates the wrong store or toast system.

risksAndGaps.title: record_rebalance trusts caller-supplied 'before' balances
risksAndGaps.description: The on-chain rebalance audit-trail instruction takes balances_before from the caller without independent on-chain verification; only balances_after is read live. Documented as a known limitation, not yet hardened.

risksAndGaps.title: No on-chain rebalance trade execution exists
risksAndGaps.description: record_rebalance only logs a before/after snapshot; there is no program instruction that itself executes a swap/trade as part of rebalancing a Reserve's composition. Any actual rebalancing trade happens off-chain/manually before the log entry is recorded.

risksAndGaps.title: Local Solana validator testing is blocked on the current dev machine
risksAndGaps.description: solana-test-validator/anchor test fail with ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD (symlink creation needs Windows Developer Mode). All protocol testing currently happens against live DevNet instead of localnet, which is slower and consumes real (if free) DevNet resources/rate limits.

risksAndGaps.title: Both frontend and protocol deployment are entirely manual, with no CI/CD pipeline
risksAndGaps.description: vercel.json sets git.deploymentEnabled: false (pushes never auto-deploy); the Solana program is deployed/upgraded via manual `anchor build`/`solana program deploy` commands, recorded only in prose docs (DEVNET_RUNBOOK.md, DECISION_LOG.md), not in a pipeline config.

risksAndGaps.title: No automated browser+wallet end-to-end test exists
risksAndGaps.description: A real browser+Phantom click-through has never been performed per PROJECT_STATUS.md; ~18 scripts/verify_*.ts scripts substitute for this using disposable keypairs and direct code calls, which validate the logic but not actual browser/extension interaction.

risksAndGaps.title: Main JS bundle exceeds 500kB
risksAndGaps.description: Flagged as a risk in PROJECT_STATUS.md; no code-splitting/lazy-loading strategy has been recorded as decided or implemented for the Merge pages.

risksAndGaps.title: Broader testing site has no authentication, relying on obscurity by design (DEC-0004/0005)
risksAndGaps.description: Only /internal/status and /internal/feedback are password-gated; the rest of the app (including real fund-touching Buy/Sell/Create flows against a real deployed program) is fully public. This is a recorded, deliberate decision for this testing phase, not an oversight -- but PROJECT_STATUS.md lists whether to move to real auth as an open decision required before further stages.

risksAndGaps.title: devnet-fixtures/ is listed in .gitignore yet its files were present and readable in the working tree
risksAndGaps.description: Worth confirming whether checkpoint.json/keypair files under devnet-fixtures/ are actually tracked in Git (force-added, ignoring the rule) or merely present locally and not distributed with a fresh clone -- if the latter, a fresh clone would be missing files that scripts/tests/the SDK's fixtures.ts depend on.

risksAndGaps.title: A second program (ssr_devnet_amm) has a generated IDL but no corresponding source directory was found under programs/
risksAndGaps.description: target/idl/ssr_devnet_amm.json exists alongside ssr_protocol's IDL, referenced by the Jupiter-infeasibility decision (DEC-0051) as a deferred experimental AMM, but its resume-or-defer status and current source location are unresolved per PROJECT_STATUS.md's own 'Decisions Required' section.

risksAndGaps.title: Anchor.toml's test script and package.json's test:program script reference different tsconfig paths
risksAndGaps.description: Anchor.toml's [scripts] test references root ./tsconfig.json while package.json's test:program script (and the one actually documented as in use) references ./tests/tsconfig.json -- a real discrepancy between the two configs, not resolved during this pass.

risksAndGaps.title: Root README.md is unmodified generic Vite template boilerplate
risksAndGaps.description: Contains no project-specific information about SSR.fun at all -- a new contributor reading only README.md would learn nothing about this project; CLAUDE.md and docs/project/docs/protocol are the real onboarding sources.
